source_budget_units: Half-L1 balanced integer-code command variation ticks; not power or energy.
STOP_semantics: Command is returned to zero by paying its reserved variation cost, STOP latches permanently. Constant source bias/drift continue; currents are not asserted zero.
interpretation: Empirical conservatism diagnostics for these full-budget command timings/axes and fixed models. Near-full total variation does not imply maximum energy, thermal cycling or RF damage. Prefix rainflow memory is reported separately. No worst-case or universal numerical conservatism factor is established.
standalone_tail_RF_diagnostic: Auxiliary RF initialized with the tail initial temperature and no historical cycles; not additive to prefix RF and never used for admission. Its purpose is to resolve small tail cycling hidden by much larger inherited double-precision RF totals. Full retained-memory RF checks remain authoritative; no exact zero-damage claim.
raw_temperature_key_note: maximum_temperature_K in inherited per-case audit stores absolute degrees C on a40 C baseline; temperature differences are K.
unbounded_tau_coverage: Inherited analytic certificate, not finite ODE samples.
gain_ray: a=1+lambda simultaneously scales local R/case, kappa, spatial gain, common modal gains relative to baseline uppers; other gains may independently lie below each upper.
baseline: Original local R/case uppers, nominal kappa upper, spatial multiplier 1, common modal gain uppers 1.25 times nominal.
RF_sampling: 4x and8x every command tick in all84cases;16x atthree full tighter controls. Sampled evidence, not continuous RF enclosure.
